label: Async and batch fee adapter
summary: Scope-cumulative fee-liability accounting with fill replay protection across asynchronous batches whose settlement is designed separately.
maturityMeaning: Hash-bound reference scaffold only; project-specific implementation and evidence are required before prototype readiness.
dependencyRequirements: Project-specific fill, cancellation and settlement adapter
requiredFacts: Bind one immutable canonical scope id, every batch id, every fill id, the gross-volume basis and final settlement event
Preserve cumulative rounding remainder when batches rotate inside one canonical scope; a new batch must never reset the scope total
Bind duplicate fill, cancellation, expiry, partial fill and replay behavior
Keep platform liability, project liability and user principal separately attributable
hardConflictPredicates: The same scope-bound fill id can accrue or settle more than once
Changing or rotating a batch id inside one canonical scope resets cumulative gross volume, platform liability or rounding remainder
A caller can rotate the canonical scope id for one economic execution surface to avoid cumulative fee accounting
A batch can be marked settled before all declared liabilities are backed
Cancellation or expiry can erase an already accrued platform liability
